## 更新内容 / Changes

- 新增「设置 → 图片生成 → 默认图片模型」，可直接输入模型 ID、保存或恢复默认值，后续切换图片模型无需改代码。默认值更新为 `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst`。
- 图片模型随本机设置和加密备份保存、恢复，并下发到独立实例及共享本地 API。未指定模型的 JSON 生图与 multipart 编辑请求使用保存值；供应商请求显式指定的模型、原生字段及图片字节保持不变。
- 保留历史图片模型名的兼容路径，继续检查供应商模型范围与访问密钥权限。配置一个模型 ID 不代表供应商支持该模型，也不会扩大密钥权限。
- 保存后，新启动的本地服务或实例使用新设置。运行中的服务保留当前配置，界面明确提示重启后应用；不会自动中断请求。本设置不更改独立第三方 MCP 服务的配置或请求中显式指定的模型。

- Adds **Settings → Image generation → Default image model**, with an editable model ID, save and reset controls. Change models without editing code; the initial value is now `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst`.
- Persists the setting through local storage and encrypted backup/restore and projects it into dedicated instances and shared local APIs. JSON generations and multipart edits without a model use the saved value; explicit provider models, native fields and image bytes are preserved.
- Retains historical image aliases and enforces provider and access-key model scopes. A configured ID does not establish provider availability or expand authorization.
- New service/instance starts apply the saved model. Active services keep their current configuration and the UI explains the restart requirement without interrupting requests. This setting does not modify independent third-party MCP configuration or explicitly selected request models.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP 和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。账号、实例、会话及本地配置保留。运行实例结束且管理器完全退出后再切换新版；普通退出可能保留后台服务。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证；Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Accounts, instances, sessions and settings are retained. Switch versions after active instances finish and the manager exits completely; ordinary Quit may retain background services. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

支持 Codex 桌面 / CLI、macOS Claude Desktop 独立实例的客户端内登录或 API / 第三方连接，以及 macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的 API Key、Bearer 和订阅 OAuth 连接；客户端需单独安装。本次更新针对管理器的图片模型设置与本地图片 API。

Supports Codex desktop / CLI, independent macOS Claude Desktop instances with in-client sign-in or API / third-party connections, and the official native macOS Claude Code CLI with API Key, Bearer or subscription OAuth connections. Install clients separately. This update covers manager image-model settings and the local Images API.

## 验证来源 / Verification

使用源码构建的转发程序和本机模拟服务，验证默认与自定义模型、JSON / multipart、显式模型优先、权限拒绝、历史别名及备份恢复。真实管理器界面验证输入错误、保存失败、保存与重新加载、恢复默认值，以及运行期间保存后重启应用新模型。Go、TypeScript、构建和打包验证结果在公开发布记录中关联准确提交与流水线。未调用真实付费图片模型，也未验证所配置模型的供应商可用性或生成质量。

Source-built relay and loopback fixtures verify default/custom models, JSON/multipart, explicit overrides, authorization denial, historical aliases and backup restoration. Actual manager UI checks cover validation, failed saves, save/reload/reset and applying saved image models after a service restart. The published release links Go, TypeScript, build and package checks to the exact commit and workflow. No paid image request is made; provider availability and image quality for the configured model are not claimed as verified.
